revoked.title: Access removed
revoked.body: This account no longer administers Bookparking. Sign in again with an administrator account.

banner: You are acting on behalf of the site. Every action is logged with its reason.

activity.title: What is moving
activity.hint: The last twenty-four hours, compared with the last seven days.

attention.title: Needs watching
attention.hint: Three questions that call for a decision from you.
attention.calm: Nothing needs your attention right now.

metric.suspendedHint: They can no longer sign in.
metric.unpublishedListingsHint: Withdrawn by their owner or by administration.
metric.pendingRequestsHint: The owner has not answered yet.
metric.confirmedRequestsHint: The space is booked for those dates.
metric.revenueHint: Sum of confirmed requests, at the price frozen when they were made.
metric.staleRequestsHint: Pending for more than twenty-four hours.
metric.pricelessListingsHint: Active, but no tier filled in: nobody can book.
metric.idleAccountsHint: Neither a listing nor a request since sign-up.
metric.openIssuesHint: The money of these rentals is frozen until you decide.

requests.title: Rental requests
requests.subtitle: {{total}} request(s), {{waiting}} of them unanswered for more than a day.
requests.caption: Rental requests received on Bookparking

moderation.reasonHint: Ten characters minimum. This text is kept: it is what will answer, six months from now, whoever asks why.

validation.reason: The reason must be at least ten characters long.

unpublish.title: Unpublish this listing
unpublish.body: The listing disappears from searches. Its owner is not notified by the application.

suspend.title: Suspend this account
suspend.body: The account will no longer be able to sign in. Its listings stay online.

lift.title: Lift the suspension
lift.body: The account will be able to sign in again immediately.

cancelRequest.title: Cancel this request
cancelRequest.body: The driver gets all their money back: the hold is released, or the payment refunded if it was already charged.

settings.subtitle: Bookparking’s rental terms. A change only applies to requests made from now on: every request already made keeps the terms of its day.

platformFeePercent.label: Commission
platformFeePercent.hint: What Bookparking keeps on each rental. Between {{min}} and {{max}}%, to the hundredth.

freeCancellationHours.label: Free cancellation
freeCancellationHours.hint: The driver is fully refunded if they cancel at least this long before the rental starts. Between {{min}} and {{max}} hours.

requestExpiryHours.label: Owner answer delay
requestExpiryHours.hint: Without confirmation within this delay, the request expires and the hold is released. Between {{min}} and {{max}} hours: a card hold only lives a few days.

payoutReleaseDelayHours.label: Money release
payoutReleaseDelayHours.hint: Money goes to the owner as soon as the driver confirms their arrival, or at the latest this long after the rental starts. Between {{min}} and {{max}} hours.

validation.decimal: A number between {{min}} and {{max}}, to the hundredth.
validation.reason: The reason must be at least 10 characters long.

settings.reasonHint: Ten characters at least. It is written to the journal with the old and new values.
settings.saved: Settings saved. They apply to requests made from now on.
settings.history: See the history in the journal

issues.subtitle: {{open}} report(s) to decide, {{total}} in all. The money of an open report is frozen: no payout goes to the owner before your decision.
issues.noMessage: The driver added nothing to the reason.
issues.noReply: The owner has not answered yet.

body.REFUND: The booking is cancelled and the driver gets back everything they paid, commission included. The owner receives nothing.
body.PARTIAL_REFUND: The amount goes back to the driver, taken from the owner’s share; the owner receives the rest on the planned date.
body.DISMISS: The money is released to the owner on the planned date. The driver is not refunded.

dialog.amountHint: From €0.01 to {{max}}, taken from the owner’s share.
